title: About Roles in the Multi-Tenant Portal for Partners

blocks.text: Zscaler Multi-Tenant Portal for Partners provides a Role-based Access Control (RBAC) feature that allows you to create and customize admin role templates as required.
A role template in the Multi-Tenant Portal for Partners can allow or restrict access to different function modules of the portal as defined by the admin.

For example, a role template can provide full access to the Tenants page but view-only access to Policy Templates. Another role template can provide permissions to edit admins while not giving permissions to view the tenants, and so on.
The Roles page provides the following benefits and enables you to:

blocks.item: Create customized RBAC templates for different function modules in the Multi-Tenant Portal for Partners.
Create customized RBAC templates for products managed by the Multi-Tenant Portal for Partners.
Assign role templates to different admin users as needed.

blocks.text: On the Roles page, you can do the following:

blocks.item: View a list of roles in your customer account. For each role, you can see:
Name: The name of the role.
Full Access: The sections an admin user with this role can access fully.
View-Only Access: The sections an admin user with this role can view but not edit.
Description: The description of the role.
Actions: The actions an admin user with full access can take (e.g., edit or delete a role).
